question: The shares of the public sector and the private sector in the production of steel during 1990-91 were __________, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is **__46% and 54% __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian steel industry:-**

 
 
• The Indian steel industry has undergone a significant transformation since the early 1990s.
 
• Prior to this period, the public sector played a dominant role in the industry, accounting for over 80% of steel production.
 
• However, since the early 1990s, there has been a gradual shift towards private sector participation.
 
• **As a result, the share of the private sector in steel production increased to 54% in 1990-91, while the share of the public sector decreased to 46%.**
